notes.title: Announcement
notes.notes:
Thank you once again to all the players who purchased the game,
as well as those who played—whether you gave up or completed it.
Please remember to leave your review and feedback,
whether it's positive or negative,
as it will be a great help to me!

[hr][/hr]
The game’s translation has now been fully optimized.
If you encounter any bugs or translation issues,
please leave a message in the discussion forum,
and I will respond as soon as possible!

[hr][/hr]
I will continue to create similar games.
If you enjoy this type of game,
please follow me for future releases!

Magic Kube Game Studio. Tim

notes.title: A Letter from the Developer
notes.notes:
First of all, I would like to thank all players who have purchased the game,
and also thank those who have taken the time to complete the game!
The game itself has undergone extensive testing by many players,
and throughout the testing process, continuous adjustments and corrections were made,
which led to the current official release version.

[hr][/hr]
I would greatly appreciate any feedback from everyone who plays the game.
Whether it's positive or negative, please feel free to share your thoughts and suggestions,
your reviews will be a huge help to me,
and they will help improve future projects!

[hr][/hr]
The Japanese translation of the game is still being revised,
and we expect to update it in about a week.

notes.title: 🎉 The Ultimate Gate will officially release on January 25th! 🎉
notes.notes:
Hello, players!
I’m Tim,
the developer behind the first game from my personal studio, Magic Kube Game Studio:
The Ultimate Gate.

This game focuses on puzzles and escape room elements,
featuring highly challenging levels and puzzle designs.
As players explore, they’ll gradually uncover the essence of the game.
I hope everyone will enjoy it!

The game is officially launching on January 25th,
with a release discount of 40% off.
If you’re interested, don’t miss it—add it to your wishlist now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3185400/

notes.title: 🎉The Ultimate Gate, will officially launch in two weeks! 🎉
notes.notes:
We are excited to announce that we’ve finally resolved the technical issues!
Our game, The Ultimate Gate, will officially launch in two weeks! 🎉

This game is the result of our passion and hard work.
We’ve carefully designed challenging puzzles and an engaging storyline,
hoping to deliver an unforgettable adventure for our players.

Mark your calendars and get ready to step through the gate!
The adventure begins on January 25, 2025.

Thank you for your support, and we can’t wait to share this game with you!
